## Report

PR [#152](https://github.com/luissiviero/sdlc-framework/pull/152) — gate (e) **parked**, iterations 3 of cap 2 (non-routine).

Wrote the missing incident lesson (`lessons/2026-10-security-authz-the-guardrail-self-protec.md`), the eval case (`evals/cases/0002-security-authz-the-guardrail-self-protec/`), rebuilt `lessons/index.md`, and split a `plan.md` bullet so `plan_sync.py` recognizes `checks.yaml` — all per review #5487900535. A fresh review pass on that commit then found this round's own regression: `tests/test_evals.py::test_the_framework_suite_s_cases_load`'s literal list wasn't updated for the new case folder. Fixing it required another iteration bump, which hit the cap (3 > 2) — so per the fix command's own rule, the one-line fix is written up but **not applied**; it's reverted from the working tree and spelled out verbatim in `evidence/fix-response.md` for the next round.

Requests left open: the pytest fix (named verbatim in fix-response.md) and the gate's own park. The owner un-parks with `sdlc:reset-iterations` on PR #152, or `gate/cli.py set-iterations --id 0002 --count 0`.
